items.title: Home Lab SOC Setup with Splunk & Snort
items.description: Configured a complete virtual SOC environment using VirtualBox, Snort IDS, Splunk Enterprise, and Kali Linux. Simulated real attack traffic and crafted custom detection rules for brute-force and port scanning attacks.
items.documentation: Full setup guide available on technical blog

items.title: Automated Python PCAP Analyzer & Threat Parser
items.description: Developed a custom Python script using Scapy and PyShark to parse raw network capture files (.pcap), extract suspicious DNS queries, detect plain-text credentials, and output structured JSON summaries.

items.title: Digital Forensics Memory & Disk Investigation Case
items.description: Conducted a complete memory and disk forensic investigation on an infected Windows 10 image. Used Volatility 3 to extract injected DLLs and Autopsy to reconstruct file access timelines.

items.title: Enterprise Network Infrastructure Simulation
items.description: Designed a multi-VLAN enterprise network architecture in Cisco Packet Tracer with OSPF routing, Access Control Lists (ACLs), DHCP snooping, and IPsec VPN tunnel between branch offices.

items.title: Web Application Penetration Testing Lab
items.description: Performed ethical penetration testing against OWASP Juice Shop and DVWA. Documented vulnerabilities including Blind SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), and Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR).

items.title: Metasploitable 2 Vulnerability Assessment & Hardening
items.description: Audited Metasploitable 2 using Nmap, Nessus, and manual exploitation techniques. Formulated a mitigation blueprint detailing service patching, SSH key enforcement, and firewall configuration.
